تزحزحت (form IIq)
# تَزَحْزَحْتُ (tazaḥzaḥtu) /ta.zaħ.zaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# تَزَحْزَحْتَ (tazaḥzaḥta) /ta.zaħ.zaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# تَزَحْزَحْتِ (tazaḥzaḥti) /ta.zaħ.zaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَزَحْزَحَ (tazaḥzaḥa)
# تَزَحْزَحَتْ (tazaḥzaḥat) /ta.zaħ.za.ħat/: t
